name: Minimal Single-Sentence Prompt (Detokenized)
description: Identical to p002 but the single-sentence context is detokenized from the Penn-Treebank-style source tokens into natural English (punctuation, contractions, and quotation marks restored) before the target is marked. Minimal English WSD prompt: only the target sentence with <t>...</t> target marking, candidate senses with index, definition, and at most one usage example, and a plain integer answer. Candidate senses are ordered by WordNet frequency.
